comment: prisma.config.ts and everything under prisma/ is CLI-only. Compiling any of it drags tsc's inferred rootDir up to the workspace root, moving the entrypoint from dist/main.js to dist/src/main.js — and because nest start still launches dist/main, the API silently keeps running the last build from before the move. The whole directory is excluded rather than each file, so adding a script there cannot reintroduce that. All of it is still typechecked by tsconfig.json.
